title: Completion and done
summary: Failure and cancellation atomically abort live QA executions and retract unsettled run obligations; passing evidence and standing plans survive. Removing a member retracts every unsettled run copy of its QA, even one that passed before a later failure, because completion grades each copy's latest attempt. Completed captures retain independent typed review authority. A failed-run retry restores automatic QA retirements and requires a new walk; manual retirements remain.
